pages.title: Configuring Effects
pages.text:
Nourished exposes all bonus and penalty effects through its config file. Server owners can change which potion effects are applied, their duration, amplifier, and the thresholds that trigger them.

The config is located at $(bold)config/nourished-server.toml$().

pages.title: Per-Group Settings
pages.text:
Each food group has its own block in the config with the following fields:

$(bold)bonusEffect$() — effect ID applied when the group is healthy.
$(bold)penaltyEffect$() — effect ID applied when the group is depleted.
$(bold)goodThreshold$() — minimum value to receive the bonus.
$(bold)criticalThreshold$() — value at which the penalty activates.

pages.title: Disabling Effects
pages.text:
To disable a bonus or penalty for a specific group, set the effect ID to $(bold)"none"$(). The bar will still track nutrition but no potion effect will be applied for that group.

This is useful for lighter server experiences or modpacks with their own progression systems.
